mechanism: Valbenazine is a substrate of CYP3A4 and P-gp, while mycophenolate undergoes enterohepatic recirculation via glucuronidation; potential for altered metabolism and additive CNS effects in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor for increased valbenazine side effects (dyskinesia, somnolence, QT prolongation) and consider alternative antiemetic if CNS symptoms worsen; maintain standard mycophenolate monitoring in transplant patients.
